title: When AI Democratizes Exploitation: LLM-Assisted Strategic Manipulation of Fair Division Algorithms
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measured the ability of a Large Language Model to generate strategic manipulation strategies for fair division algorithms, specifically in a rent-division scenario.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the strategic manipulation of fair division algorithms using LLMs.
